LOCAL HAPPENINGS
Charles White Park Reimagined in Altadena
Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena. Plans bring together
an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, and a new
recreation center. Native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art will give visitors
more ways to play, gather, and explore the five-acre park. If you live in 90004, this gives you a future county outing to
look forward to, with play areas, gardens, and recreation in Altadena.

narration.title: Home Values
narration.text: In Hancock Park and Larchmont, 90004, home prices are down 26.3% from a year ago, so buyers should compare recent sales.

narration.title: Realtor Introduction
narration.text: Quick note for agents: Los Angeles County is open for sponsorship. Learn more at agentsautomated.com.

narration.title: Median sale prices
narration.text: Median sale prices are now $1.28M, down 26.3% from a year ago and down 10% from five years ago. Buyers comparing budgets should use the latest completed sales as their reference point.

narration.title: Price per square foot
narration.text: Price per square foot is $759, down 7.3% from a year ago. Buyers comparing homes of similar size and condition should look closely at what those homes actually sold for.

narration.title: Available homes
narration.text: There are 165 homes available, up 1.9% from a year ago and up 12.2% from five years ago. Buyers have a slightly wider selection to choose from.

narration.title: Median days on market
narration.text: The median days on market is 60, down 11.8% from a year ago. Sellers can plan a marketing timeline around that figure, though it is not a promised sale date.

narration.title: Homes sold
narration.text: Homes sold total 36 in the 3 months ending October, down 26.5% from a year ago. Sellers should weigh these completed transactions when reviewing their asking price.

narration.title: Sales above, at and below asking
narration.text: Most homes sold below asking, more common than last year.

narration.title: Local happenings
narration.text: Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena, with an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, a new recreation center, native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art across the five-acre park.

narration.title: Sale-to-list percentage
narration.text: Homes are selling for about 3% under their final asking price. Sellers can review completed comparable sales before choosing an asking price.

pageValues.local_body: Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena. Plans bring together an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, and a new recreation center. Native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art will give visitors more ways to play, gather, and explore the five-acre park. If you live in 90004, this gives you a future county outing to look forward to, with play areas, gardens, and recreation in Altadena.
